sayLines.text: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
📓 Codex: you've heard of **Long Table**. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 40. I've been watching what you're becoming, little living. Names for your shelf: Photosynthesis, Long Table. What they DO — that's still yours to learn."

◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

💛 You hold Tasting Spoon. Your first Saturday service, you were sixteen and the chef handed you this spoon without a word. Tap twice, taste, know. You still tap twice — the tickets are gone but the habit isn't. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.
